response.enhanced_information: Constriction of the afferent arteriole decreases blood flow into the glomerulus, leading to reduced hydrostatic pressure and a lower glomerular filtration rate (GFR). This reduction in GFR results in decreased urine production. The activation of the renin-angiotensin system due to decreased renal blood flow can further reduce urine output by increasing sodium and water reabsorption. This sequence of events is supported by the anatomical and functional roles of the kidney glomerulus and afferent arteriole in regulating urine output.
